messages:
olivia-partners: Quick heads-up  CatalystWeights dropped Catalyst-7B-v3 artifacts into their share. LICENSE.txt is research-only + 'no redistribution'. They also included a VectorChip-optimized kernel binary and a closed converter. Need legal + eng alignment on acceptable partner lanes: marketplace tile, hosted API, Dedicated, SI installs.
sam-legal: Research-only prevents commercial marketplace listing and resale for Dedicated. Short path: negotiate a narrow Distribution License Addendum (DLA) that permits hosting and distribution of compiled runtime artifacts while prohibiting raw checkpoint redistribution. Require export/compliance disclosure.
kevin-eng: Tech notes: bundle has FP32 checkpoints, tokenizer, converter that calls a closed binary, and a VectorChip kernel (ARM64). If they won't allow raw weights, we can do hosted endpoints but need a redistributable runtime binary with checksum or kernel source. Also request a small eval/regression set.
nina-ops: Ops: do NOT accept cross-account CI roles for their bucket. Ask for presigned, time-limited URLs and a signed manifest (SHA256) per file. Prefer GPG-signed provenance and object locking off until verification. For SI installs, we need permission to distribute installer images to customer accounts.
hannah-ml: Ask for a compatibility matrix: max context length, tokenizer normalization, FP16/INT8 support, kv-cache semantics. Also request perf numbers on VectorChip and commodity GPUs (throughput, mem/token) for model profile and Optimize suggestions.
mike-marketing: Marketing wants a joint announcement in ~3 weeks. Can we promise a marketplace tile if legal + eng agree this week? Need approved copy and packaging.
olivia-partners: Sam  can you paste a short starter clause we can send CatalystWeights to speed negotiations? We'll propose two lanes in the outreach.
sam-legal: Starter clause: "Supplier grants Redwood a non-exclusive, worldwide, sublicensable license to host, serve, and distribute compiled runtime artifacts (containers, quantized binaries). Redistribution of raw checkpoints is prohibited. Supplier must provide a signed manifest (SHA256), provenance with build steps and converter versions, and disclose kernel redistribution permissions. SI/on-prem transfers require a per-customer addendum and KYC. Supplier will declare export controls."
kevin-eng: Add to outreach: request redistributable kernel binary + checksum or source, a smoke test script, and a small eval/regression bundle (20-50 prompts) with expected outputs to validate quantization. We'll also need a runtime compatibility doc.
nina-ops: Ops checklist to include in email: presigned artifact URLs, SHA256 manifest, GPG-signed provenance, audit logging for SI images, and no cross-account write roles.
mike-marketing: If Catalyst agrees to hosting + manifest this week, marketing can prepare joint collateral. Otherwise timeline slips.
ops-bot: created TICKET PARTNERS-703: "CatalystWeights DLA + artifact checklist" assigned to olivia-partners.
olivia-partners: Drafting email now. Will loop CatalystWeights PM + engineering lead and post replies here. Goal: lock DLA + packaging in 10 business days for marketing window.
